steps.en: Report of records in tagging files sent out
steps.id: Report record di tagging file yang dikirim
steps.why_en: Only a record count is logged; no report of the file records exists.
steps.why_id: Hanya jumlah record yang dicatat di log; tidak ada report isi file.

steps.en: Report of tagged vehicles and IDs sent to DOS
steps.id: Report kendaraan dan ID tagged yang dikirim ke DOS
steps.why_en: Nothing is sent to DOS, so there is nothing to report.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang dikirim ke DOS, jadi tidak ada yang dilaporkan.

steps.en: Report of details received from DOS
steps.id: Report detail yang diterima dari DOS
steps.why_en: A DOS screen exists but is switched off and is not a tagging report.
steps.why_id: Layar DOS ada tetapi dimatikan dan bukan report tagging.

steps.en: Report of records added to or removed from hitlists
steps.id: Report record yang ditambah atau dihapus dari hitlist
steps.why_en: No hitlist exists, so no additions or removals are tracked.
steps.why_id: Hitlist tidak ada, jadi tidak ada tambah atau hapus yang dicatat.

steps.en: Officer downloads tagging reports from the portal
steps.id: Officer mengunduh report tagging dari portal
steps.why_en: The Report page exists but has no tagging report to download.
steps.why_id: Halaman Report ada tetapi tidak punya report tagging untuk diunduh.
